content: Replay usable entries are accepted without frozen-input, source SHA, workspace, verified or current PG source validation; missing body silently shrinks the full set and may still report success.
Typed targets are never retained in rerank output (real artifact: 3 to 0), and degraded fallback entries omit doc_id, SHA and paths.

Gold/unknown/replay structural errors bypass failure writer; replay read occurs outside post-guard finally. HTTP receipts never populate live_receipts. Large integer score OverflowError exposes the lost receipt path.

Raw response index/score arrays are stripped, preventing independent actual-response verification; error response text is stored without removing configured secrets, and an echoed fixture API key appears verbatim in the terminal.
